ora·ïto — projects — Eva armchair

Eva armchair

Category Furniture
Brand Zanotta
Collection Zanotta
Year 2009

Its organic shape and the opening at the bottom of the backrest take up the spirit of the Evolution armchair (also designed by Ora-Ito for Zanotta in 2007). Eva perfectly illustrates Ora-Ito's work: sober and futuristic lines, a universal and timeless style that can brave time while remaining elegant. The rounded shell is made of integral polyurethane reinforced by a steel insert. Its rounded and ergonomic shapes ensure optimal comfort. The central leg and the swivel base are in varnished steel.
